subject: BridgeProof POC - environment prerequisites & MAP cadence
messages:
From: Darius Khan <darius.khan@bridgeproof.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leah Morgan <leah.morgan@bridgeproof.com>
Date: 2029-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BridgeProof POC - environment prerequisites & initial timeline

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our execs liked the performance numbers. We want to kick off a short evaluation to validate throughput and latency in our inter-region setup. To keep the trial tight, can you confirm the environment prerequisites and a suggested cadence for the MAP? High level asks from our infra and security teams:

- A scoped Redwood org for BridgeProof evaluation (service accounts & role separation)
- Short-lived API keys or ephemeral service account tokens for the POC
- IP allowlist ranges we should open on our firewall for Redwood egress (and any inbound ranges for VPC peering)
- VPC peering checklist / peering contact + required subnet ranges
- Expected timeline to get to a functional tenant we can run parallel workload tests against (we're targeting a 2-week evaluation)

Attaching our internal network inventory and the MAP template the procurement team prefers. Can Marissa or Neha be looped for any commercial/contract questions?

Leah and I can run a short mutual-action plan review on Monday. Let me know what you need from our side to start network and org provisioning.

Thanks,
Darius Khan
Director of Engineering, BridgeProof

Attachments: bridgeproof_network_inventory.csv, bridgeproof_map_template.xlsx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Darius Khan <darius.khan@bridgeproof.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2029-05-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeProof POC - environment prerequisites & initial timeline

Darius — thanks for the clear list. I'm attaching a filled-in MAP draft and a short checklist we use for rapid evals. High-level reply below; details and exact CIDRs are in the attachment.

MAP / POC kickoff summary (short):
- Redwood will provision a scoped BridgeProof evaluation org under a timebound workspace.
- We'll issue one short-lived API key set (30d) + instructions to mint ephemeral service tokens for test runners.
- IP allowlist: please allow outbound to Redwood egress ranges and inbound from our peering subnets; provisional egress CIDRs: 34.82.12.0/24, 34.82.13.0/24. (Final ranges depend on region and will be confirmed after peering selection.)
- VPC peering: we support AWS Classic peering and AWS Transit Connect. Required from you: peering request with the VPC ID, region, and a primary peering contact. Our network team will provide a peering template with required route tables and shared subnet ranges.
- Acceptance criteria (what we agree will mark the POC as successful):
  * End-to-end generation latency under your 120ms SLO for 1k concurrent tokens in staging pattern A.
  * Validation of KV cache behavior on repeated prefix requests.
  * Tokenized cost estimate within 20% of projected baseline.

Logistics & next steps:
1) I'll attach: bridgeproof_poc_map_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), redwood_temp_api_key_instructions.txt (how to use temporary keys + rotate), and a short peering checklist.
2) Marissa will handle commercial terms and an upcoming MSA/IO review.
3) Neha will be the primary infra handoff for peering and the IP allowlist.
4) Proposed cadence: initial tech handoff today -> network peering request within 48 hours -> creds & test tenant provisioned within 72 hours of signed NDA/IO.

If that timeline works, can you confirm the peering contact and whether your netops prefers a specific maintenance window?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: bridgeproof_poc_map_v1.xlsx, redwood_temp_api_key_instructions.txt

From: Darius Khan <darius.khan@bridgeproof.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leah Morgan <leah.morgan@bridgeproof.com>, Network Ops <netops@bridgeproof.com>
Date: 2029-05-14T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeProof POC - environment prerequisites & initial timeline

On Tue, May 14, 2029 at 11:03 AM Soojin Lee wrote:
> If that timeline works, can you confirm the peering contact and whether your netops prefers a specific maintenance window?

Thanks Soojin — that looks good. Our netops contact is Jorge (netops@bridgeproof.com); I'll also submit the peering request today and paste the ticket here once created. We prefer a maintenance window Sunday 02:00–04:00 PT for peering handshakes to avoid peak traffic.

A couple of clarifying requests from our security lead:
- Can Redwood provide an option to issue scoped API keys bound to a single service account so we can enforce least privilege?
- Do you support SAML SSO for console login and an option to provision service accounts through SAML assertions (we can share metadata)?

We'll circulate the signed IO after Marissa confirms the updated pricing line item.

—Darius
Darius Khan
Director of Engineering, BridgeProof

Attachment: bridgeproof_peering_request_ticket_draft.txt

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Darius Khan <darius.khan@bridgeproof.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jorge Alvarez <netops@bridgeproof.com>
Date: 2029-05-15T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BridgeProof POC - environment prerequisites & initial timeline

Darius / Jorge — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming the window. Summary of what I'll action today (and who owns what):

- Soojin (Redwood) — create scoped BridgeProof evaluation org; generate one scoped API key pair (30-day) and provide steps to mint ephemeral tokens. See redwood_temp_api_key_instructions.txt.
- Neha (Redwood) — will send VPC peering template and the completed CIDR ranges for the peering subnets. Neha's note: our peering endpoints for us-west will include 34.82.12.0/24 and 34.82.13.0/24; we'll confirm final IPv6 plan if required.
- Marissa (Redwood) — will follow up on pricing and the IO; expect a redline by EOD.
- BridgeProof / Jorge — submit the peering request during the Sunday 02:00–04:00 PT window and paste the ticket URL here. Also please share SAML metadata if you want SSO configured for console users.

Quick checklist for your netops to include in the peering ticket (copy/paste):
1) BridgeProof VPC ID and region
2) BridgeProof preferred subnets for peering (non-overlapping with Redwood ranges)
3) BridgeProof ASN if using BGP (optional for AWS Classic peering)
4) Contact name and 24/7 escalation number for handshakes

Acceptance criteria reminder (from MAP):
- Tenant provisioned + ephemeral API key validated with 3 sample queries
- VPC peering established and route tables propagated
- Sample load test (1000 concurrent tokens) executed and latency report shared

I'll upload the filled MAP to the Drive link I shared and attach the API key instructions here. If anything changes on the IO, Marissa — loop us in and we'll hold provisioning until signed.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
